Vacancy for Senior Engineer (Updated)
Tuesday, 22 April 2025
1947 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the following post in the prescribed proforma (
Available here
). The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 10/05/2025.
Senior Network Engineer (Open-1):
Qualification & Experience
: Must be a B.E./B. Tech degree (Electronics/Electronics and Communication/Information Technology) related field along with MCSA (Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate) Certificate and CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) Certificate.
Must have More than 5 year’s work experience in relevant field. (Experience with CISCO products will be preferred).
More information about the experience Duties and Responsibilities required is available here
Note :
Salary as admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Only eligible candidates will be called for interview.
Society reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final & binding.
No TA and DA will be paid by Kasturba Health Society for attending the interview
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
